# WallPlan — Calendar Generator for Long-Term Planning

## Overview

WallPlan is a free online tool that generates multi-year wall calendars with Gantt charts for strategic planning. Every year we publish a new version of a multi-year calendar. The publishing industry mostly makes calendars for just the next year, limiting our ability to plan in detail many years ahead.

Fourteen years ago, in October 2012, the first such calendar covering two years was released. For many years calendars were laid out manually, until in 2020 Michael Kvrivishvili — the designer of the official Boston Metro map — developed a service specifically to generate a calendar for any number of months, with any number of Gantt rows.

- **URL**: https://osovsky.com/wallplan/
- **Author**: Maxim Osovsky (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107189449)
- **Co-author**: Michael Kvrivishvili
- **License**: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)
- **Technology**: Pure vanilla JavaScript, SVG, CSS. Zero npm dependencies.

## Features

### SVG Renderer
Pure SVG output with three calendar types:
- **Vertical**: Classic days list with day numbers and names
- **Gantt**: Horizontal planning grid with configurable rows (6, 8, 10, or 12)
- **Box**: Traditional mini month grid

### Duration
From 1 month to 20 years. Mobile scroll-wheel picker (years + months), desktop number input.

### Hide Days Mode
Toggle to hide day-level details (numbers, names, holidays, grid lines) from Vertical and Gantt views. Gantt horizontal rows redistribute to fill the full height — ideal for long-term strategic planning. Persisted via `&d=1` URL parameter.

### Paper Sizes
- A4, A3 (automatic page fitting, 7–8 months per page)
- 914mm single roll
- 914mm ×2 (dual copies)
- 914mm ×4 (quad copies)

Format-specific tuning: each roll format has optimized cell widths — 4mm (single), 2.7mm (×2), 1.7mm (×4) — and font scaling for readability at each physical size.

### Export
Download as vector SVG or PDF with embedded IBM Plex Sans fonts. Free, no login required.

### Customizable
- Week start: Monday or Sunday
- US, Russian, and Chinese holidays display
- Adjustable Gantt rows: 6, 8, 10, or 12
- Weekend/holiday highlighting: pink background, 3 levels (Gantt → +Box → +Vertical). URL: `&h=1/2/3`

### Locale System
Three locales via `locales/*.js` files:
- English (`locales/en.js`): US Federal holidays
- Russian (`locales/ru.js`): Russian holidays + transferred days (Gov Decree 1466)
- Chinese (`locales/zh.js`): 2026 State Council holidays, zodiac, 补班 workday overrides

Single shared `calendar.js` reads `window.LOCALE` at runtime.

### Chinese Calendar (`/zh/`)
English UI with Chinese public holidays and zodiac year labels. Designed for businesses planning around China's work schedule.
- **Holidays**: Spring Festival, Qingming, Labour Day, Dragon Boat, Mid-Autumn, National Day (2026 State Council decree)
- **补班 workday overrides**: Makeup workdays excluded from weekend highlighting
- **Chinese Zodiac**: Animal + element/color label (e.g. "🐴 Fire Horse") above 2nd month of each year
- **EN/RU/中 language toggle**: Switch month names, weekdays, and holiday names between 3 languages
- **RU/CN Holiday Overlay**: Shows Russian holidays in gray over Chinese calendar, with stats popup (`137/365`)
- **URL params**: `&lang=ru`, `&ov=1` for shareable links

### Custom Entries
Add session-only text annotations on any date via the W button (Copper Penny DTP font). Supports DD.MM date input with auto-formatting (all delimiters supported). Yearly repeat option. Entries render alongside holidays and export to SVG/PDF. Not persisted — cleared on page reload.

### Month Color Palette
Optional temperature-based color encoding for month names, day numbers, and day-of-week labels. Toggle via toolbar button (concentric circles icon = off, Itten color wheel = on). Persisted via `&c=1` URL parameter. Colors use inline `style.fill` to override CSS defaults. Weekend days remain red regardless of month color.

The palette reflects real Northern Hemisphere seasonal climate — warmth starts only in May:

| Month | Hex | Color | Meaning |
|-------|---------|-------------|-------------------------------|
| Jan | #212121 | Black | Dead cold, darkness |
| Feb | #3F51B5 | Indigo | Winter depth |
| Mar | #9C27B0 | Purple | Crocuses, first flowers |
| Apr | #2196F3 | Blue | Still cold, rain |
| May | #4CAF50 | Green | Warm, nature comes alive |
| Jun | #8BC34A | Lime | Summer, everything lush |
| Jul | #F44336 | Red | Peak heat |
| Aug | #FF9800 | Orange | Hot, but peak is over |
| Sep | #FFC107 | Amber | Golden autumn |
| Oct | #A1887F | Light Brown | Falling leaves |
| Nov | #795548 | Brown | Bare trees |
| Dec | #9E9E9E | Gray | Overcast, snow |

All colors are from Google's Material Design palette. The first version of this color scheme was applied in 2014 in the [2015–2020 calendar](https://app.box.com/s/7yqyh8vfphq9hj2lg1jw), published in the Russian magazine «Жить интересно!».

### WallPlan Day
January 11 — marked annually in Copper Penny DTP font with wine-colored accent (#6B2332).

### Mobile
Touch pan & pinch-to-zoom. iOS-like bottom toolbar with frosted glass effect shows current duration, rows count, and paper format. Settings sheet with scroll-wheel duration picker, paper format selector with roll length display, Gantt rows chips (6/8/10/12), and week start toggle. Download popup for SVG/PDF. T button for custom entries. Hide Days toggle.

### Printing
Long multi-year calendars can be printed at copy centers on engineering paper up to 1 meter wide with virtually infinite length. Custom print CSS — what you see is what you get. Ideal for working on strategies.


## Architecture

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| calendar.js | SVG renderer, viewport, pan/zoom, export (shared across all locales) |
| locales/en.js | English locale (months, weekdays, US holidays) |
| locales/ru.js | Russian locale (months, weekdays, Russian holidays + transferred days) |
| locales/zh.js | Chinese locale (holidays, zodiac, lang toggle, overlay, workday overrides) |
| style.css | Miro-style UI, Moleskine palette, responsive layout |
| index.html | Main app shell + GA4 tracking (EN) |
| zh/index.html | Chinese calendar version |
| fonts/ | IBM Plex Sans (7 weights) + Copper Penny DTP + Noto Sans SC (CJK for PDF) |
| og-image.jpg | Social preview image (1200×630) |
| COLORS.md | Month color palette reference (hex values, climate rationale) |

## Technical Details

- Pure SVG rendering via `createElementNS()` + `setAttribute()` (no innerHTML with user data)
- Batch SVG path rendering for performance
- Holiday caching
- requestAnimationFrame-based viewport updates
- Rulers and guides with cm/m labels
- Vertical guides marking printable area
- Zero external dependencies — no npm, no frameworks
- Google Analytics GA4 tracking

## Miro App

A sidebar plugin for Miro boards (separate repo: https://github.com/maximosovsky/wallplan-miro). Generates multi-year Gantt calendars as **native Miro board elements** (text, shapes, frames) — fully editable by users.

- **URL**: https://wallplan-miro.vercel.app/

### Tech Stack
- TypeScript + React, Vite, Miro Web SDK 2.0, Mirotone CSS
- Font: IBM Plex Sans (`plex_sans` — native Miro font)

### Key Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| native-generator.ts | Creates calendar as native shapes + text on Miro board |
| calendar-engine.ts | Pure date math (shared with web version) |
| generator.ts | Orchestrator — delegates to native-generator |
| app.tsx | Panel UI (React settings form) |

### Performance & Rate Limit
- No `.sync()` calls — styles passed in constructor
- Merged horizontal lines (R3: 360→31, Gantt: 120→10 shapes)
- BATCH_SIZE = 10, 500ms inter-batch delay — stays under 100K credits/min
- Progressive rendering (3 months → zoom → rest)
- Direct object storage for grouping (no `getById` loop)
- 30s pre-group delay + 3× retry for group() call
- SCALE = 16 for high-resolution zoom

### Miroverse Template
- [2-Year Timeline Gantt Calendar 2026–2027](https://miro.com/miroverse/2year-timeline-gantt-calendar-20262027/) — ready-to-use, all native elements

## Roadmap

Planned features (in order of complexity):
1. Stickers — yellow/pink SVG stickers on calendar, drag to move, double-click to edit
2. Unified Overlay System — shared rendering for stickers and images
3. Image Upload — embed photos/logos on calendar canvas
4. Additional Locales — Italian, French, Spanish, Arabic (UAE)
5. GA4 → Telegram Alerts — real-time analytics notifications
6. Google Calendar Import — auto-import birthdays and events
7. ~~Miro App — publish as Miro Marketplace plugin~~ ✓ Done (native elements, Phase 7)
8. ~~Locale Refactoring (6a)~~ ✓ Done (locales/*.js)
9. ~~Chinese Calendar (6b)~~ ✓ Done (zodiac, 补班, overlay, CJK PDF)
10. ~~Weekend/Holiday Highlighting~~ ✓ Done (pink toggle, 3 levels)
11. ~~Favicon~~ ✓ Done (favicon.png, all HTML files)
12. ~~Welcome Carousel (always)~~ ✓ Done (every mobile visit, ZH with Chinese quotes)
13. ~~Service Worker & Lighthouse~~ ✓ Done (offline PWA, aria-labels, manifest)
